description: Extract a single Instagram post with comments as structured JSON (author, caption, likes, commentCount, time, datetime, comments[{username, text, time, datetime}]). Navigate to instagram.com/p/POST_ID/ or instagram.com/reel/REEL_ID/ first. Scroll the comment area to load more comments before extracting.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_extract_ig_post
